typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblXVADailyArchive_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		AgreementID as string,
		TradeID as string,
		ProductType as string,
		Filename as string,
		Tenor as string,
		CounterParty as string,
		XVATradeaID as string,
		Input as string,
		NettingGroupID as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		WCISID as string,
		CptyHazardCurveCode as string,
		SourceSystem as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> tblXVADailyStaging
tblXVADailyStaging sink(input(
		AgreementID as string,
		TradeID as string,
		ProductType as string,
		Filename as string,
		Tenor as string,
		CounterParty as string,
		XVATradeaID as string,
		Input as string,
		NettingGroupID as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		WCISID as string,
		CptyHazardCurveCode as string,
		SourceSystem as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		AgreementID,
		TradeID,
		ProductType,
		Filename,
		Tenor,
		CounterParty,
		XVATradeaID,
		Input,
		NettingGroupID,
		Loaddate,
		WCISID,
		CptyHazardCurveCode,
		SourceSystem),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblXVADailyArchive_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblXVADailyArchive
